administration.cycle_and_sequence: Start four to six weeks after craniospinal radiotherapy, once cleared by your team. In each 42-day cycle, lomustine is taken once on Day 1, cisplatin is infused on Day 1, and vincristine is infused on Days 1, 8 and 15. Eight cycles are planned, with individual safety review.
route_and_duration: Take lomustine only once on the authorised Day 1. The pharmacist must confirm the total dose, capsule strengths, how to take it and anti-sickness timing. Do not open or crush capsules or take another dose to replace a missed or vomited one without advice. Cisplatin and vincristine are given into a vein. Day 1 includes fluids before and after cisplatin; later visits on Days 8 and 15 are for vincristine. The total visit is longer than the infusion itself.

Review nerves and bowel function before vincristine. Brain/spine imaging and any other response tests follow the individual specialist plan; no universal scan or tumour-marker timetable is set here.

regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Bevacizumab: Bevacizumab binds VEGF, a signal involved in making and maintaining blood vessels. Blocking this signal can change the blood supply and leakiness of tumour vessels. It can also affect normal vessels, which helps explain high blood pressure, protein in the urine, bleeding, clots and slower wound healing. A scan change does not by itself prove that the tumour has stopped growing.
